Interface ITreeSource

A hierarchy for a Tuinet.Widgets.TreeView`1: app-owned data addressed by integer node ids the app chooses (an index into its own array, or a key into a dictionary). The tree must not have cycles.

Remarks

Called only for the root and expanded nodes, so a lazy source (a file tree) loads a node's children the first time it is opened. If loading is async, return 0 until the data arrives, then call Tuinet.Widgets.TreeState.Invalidate.
